sections.Profile:
Solids N Stripes , released by Williams Electronic Games in February 1971, is an electro-mechanical pinball machine with a billiards theme. Designed by Norm Clark with artwork by Christian Marche, the game features two flippers, five pop bumpers, six kick-out holes, and two standup targets.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1971
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 2
- Tags: Two player, Pool (Billiards), Original Theme, 1970s
sections.Design Team:
- Design: Norm Clark
- Art: Christian Marche
